text:
—I am Death— she told me. I did not know

that she hemmed me in so closely,

to the point of pouring over my face

her troubling cold breath.


I no longer try to elude her company:

she follows my steps, transparent and clear,

and since then she does not forsake me

or leave me by night or by day.


—And to think —I confessed— that in a thousand ways

I tried to disguise you with nicknames,

confused amid fears and errors!


"You have more of caress than of grief."

You were relief and I called you chain.

You were death and I called you life.

translation.title: Visitation
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the direct encounter with Death and the final reversal of names.
